_comment: Which Korean document replaces which English one on the generated `ko` branch.
`ko` is not a place to edit. It is built from `main` by scripts/ko_sync.py, so the
canonical Korean text lives here on main as `<name>.ko.md` beside its English
sibling, and the branch is regenerated whenever main's tests pass. Editing ko
directly loses the edit at the next sync.
The branch existed as an independent fork until v0.5.5 and was three releases
behind: it still told Korean readers that the tool made no network request and that
installing meant downloading a release. Two languages of the same product cannot be
`not_yet_translated` is the visible to-do. Anything listed there stays English on
ko, which is accurate but not translated - and that is the deliberate choice: a
stale translation that makes a false claim is worse than an English page.
